confidence_notes: Holistic estimate for a Jamaican resort town. Restaurant and drink anchors are more certain than accommodation; registered hostels and hotel star categories are especially uncertain. Cocktail and wine estimates follow their typical tourist-town price relationship to beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Jamaican Caribbean resort towns such as Negril and Montego Bay, adjusted for Ocho Rios's resort and cruise tourism.
